question: To which revilers of sacred figures must the teaching never be given?
premises: The teaching must not be given
Slanderers of the Kula Bhairava are excluded
inference: The teaching must never be given to those who revile Shiva or slander the Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: The exact case relation of kulabhairave is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
